columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier. Populated automatically for Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud services customers by the Load Interface File for Import program.  Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created the row.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number.  Must be a unique whole number for the batch.

columns.name: BATCH_DIST_ID
columns.description: Batch distribution identifier.

columns.name: CCID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier.  Use the Manage Account Combinations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Intercompany distribution amount percentage.  Must be a whole number between 1 and 100.  Validation: the sum for a batch must equal 100.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Import status code.  Oracle internal use only.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
